notes: The three N15 allocations sum to exactly one terminal N15 burn per completed catalyst cycle.
The three D-T allocations sum to 0.15 burn per completed catalyst cycle.
The proton ratio equals the 80% N15 burn fraction, so the loaded driver has exactly enough protons for the modeled burn.
The 4:1 tamper ratio is fixed as the selected mass-versus-momentum reference.
The fixed 0.3-m D-T starter is charged by physical mass in addition to the normalized late-match ledger; at these batch sizes its normalized isotope cost is negligible.
Unburned driver and reaction fuel are recovered and retried.
Driver ignition and the stated D-T energy-deposition fraction are fixed premises of this reference calculation.
